title: Section 106 BSA — Fact especially within knowledge

content.overview: Section 106 of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 places the burden of proving a fact especially within a person's knowledge on that person. It is not a licence to reverse the prosecution's primary burden.
content.study: Use BSA 106 only after the party with the primary burden has laid the foundation the statute requires. In a criminal trial the prosecution must still prove the charge. Section 106 answers a narrower question: a fact especially within one person's knowledge. Article 21 procedure remains fair, just and reasonable after Maneka. Do not cite the repealed Evidence Act section 106 as current law except for pending matters saved by BSA section 170.

sections.heading: Practice point
sections.body: Name the fact said to be especially within knowledge. Do not use 106 to fill a hole in the primary case.
